_comment: AD-9 model seeding: agent-slug -> default Claude model id. Consumed once, at member-creation time, by AgentsTemplateService.DefaultModels() (see GigaClaw.Core/Services/AgentsTemplateService.cs). Editing this file after a project already has members has no effect on those members — change the member's DefaultModel directly (PATCH /api/projects/{slug}/members/{memberId}) instead. Model ids must match GigaClaw.Core/Models/ClaudeModelCatalog.cs. Agents not listed here get no explicit DefaultModel and fall back to the project's FallbackModel.
